circuits.why: One row per racing circuit with its location and coordinates; races point at it.

constructorResults.why: One constructor's points at one race; points at races, whose date times it, and at constructors, which repeat across races.

constructorStandings.why: Each constructor's cumulative championship standing as of each race; constructor plus race is unique and the race repeats across rows.

constructors.why: One row per team that builds cars; results, qualifying and standings point at it.

driverStandings.why: Each driver's cumulative championship standing as of each race; driver plus race is unique and the race repeats across rows.

drivers.why: One row per driver with name and date of birth; results, laps, stops and standings point at it.

lapTimes.why: One row per lap a driver completed in a race, keyed race, driver and lap; timed by the race's date.

pitStops.why: One row per pit stop, keyed race, driver and stop, stamped with the time of day and the lap.

qualifying.why: One driver's qualifying session at one race; points at races, drivers and constructors, timed by the race's date.

races.why: One row per grand prix, stamped with its date and pointing at the circuit and season; most tables point at it.

results.why: One driver's finishing result at one race; points at races, drivers, constructors and status.

seasons.why: Sixty-eight championship years with only a Wikipedia url, pointed at only by races.

status.why: Labels for how a driver finished (Finished, +1 Lap, Engine), pointed at only by results.

target.why: A win flag added beside driverStandings, row for row on the same ids, race and driver; it carries that table's role.
